topic: Диверсификация экспорта интегральных схем Южной Кореи и Японии: смена рынков сбыта или изменение товарной структуры?
primary_hhi_definition: Destination-country/area HHI from direct gross export values, five HS6 subheadings of HS8542, excluding World total.
limitations: Export values are nominal USD; product-mix effects can include relative-price changes.
Direct customs destinations do not reveal ultimate consumption or value-added origins.
The China plus Hong Kong calculation is a destination-aggregation sensitivity, not an estimate of re-exports to mainland China.
A descriptive decomposition does not identify a causal effect of export controls, subsidies or geopolitical events.
The five HS6 product definitions must be checked across reported HS editions before submission.
